What is KalyeSerye?

This is an offshoot short soap opera from the segment "All for Juan, Juan for All", part of the Philippine noontime show Eat Bulaga. It's a portmanteau for the Filipino words 'kalye' and 'serye', which mean street and series respectively. Part of the KalyeSerye unfolds live in the barangays where the segment is, hence the use of the term 'kalye'.

What is AlDub?

It is the tandem name of Alden Richards and Yaya Dub (Maine Mendoza), two of the central characters in the KalyeSerye. Also known as MaiDen, upon using Yaya Dub's real name.

What is v/AlDub?

This is a subverse for all things KalyeSerye and AlDub! Here you'll find stuff that will help you get to know more about the pairing that has taken the Philippines by storm this 2015.
